answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable stake bond before trading, like a gardener who must plant a walnut tree and tend it before harvesting. The bond is locked in escrow and slashed if the agent misbehaves, while honest agents keep trading and slowly earn reputation. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and a zephyr of cheap sock puppets cannot pass because each puppet needs its own locked stake, making mass forgery expensive and slow.
